description.value:
From Survivor · Price: it can make allies fight each other too.

Theme Affliction

  • 1: 2 actions: spread water in a @Template[burst|distance:20]{20-ft burst} within 30 ft for 1 minute. Creatures in it see each other's strength and take –1 to @Check[will|against:stand]{Will} saves against fear and emotion.
  • 5: Surge: enemies in the area make a @Check[will|against:stand]{Will} save or must Strike the nearest creature on their turn (incapacitation, 1 round). Allies who fail must save too.
  • 9: The area is 30 ft.
  • 13: Allies get +2 to the save.
  • 17: Creatures that critically fail continue fighting for 1 minute.

Effects @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-stand-class-archetype.stand-effects.Item.WRWZwaRtbeHbdQqm]{Effect: Rage Field}

Defaults: Stand, Occult and Concentrate traits; a surge costs 1 Stand Point and 2 actions unless listed; ranges are measured from your stand; untyped damage is force; saves use your stand DC.
